f.title: Report SUSARs to NPRA (SAE reporting to NPRA not required)
f.statement: SAE reporting to NPRA is not required, but SUSAR reporting to NPRA is mandatory. Any SAE reporting should go to the respective Ethics Committee according to its requirements.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

f.title: Treat responses with at least a reasonable possibility of causality as ADRs
f.statement: In pre-approval clinical experience, all noxious and unintended responses to a medicinal product related to any dose should be considered ADRs; a causal relationship is at least a reasonable possibility, i.e. cannot be ruled out.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

rows.quote: In the pre-approval clinical experience with a new medicinal product or its new usages, all noxious and unintended responses to a medicinal product related to any dose should be considered as ADR. The phrase responses to a medicinal product means that a causal relationship between a medicinal product and an adverse event is at least a reasonable possibility, i.e. the relationship cannot be ruled out.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source; no change. Double-check: quote proves statement, level and actor.

f.title: Apply seriousness criteria including important medical events
f.statement: A serious ADR is any untoward medical occurrence that at any dose results in death, is life-threatening, requires inpatient hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, results in persistent or significant disability/incapacity, or is a congenital anomaly/birth defect. Other important medical events that may jeopardise the subject or require intervention to prevent these outcomes should also be considered serious.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

rows.quote: Other important medical events that may not be immediately life-threatening or result in death or hospitalization, but when based on appropriate medical judgement, may jeopardise the subject or may require intervention to prevent of the outcomes in the definition of “Serious” ADR above should also be considered Serious ADR.
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the IME sentence; the outcome list is the preceding sentence of FAQ 3. Double-check: OK.

f.title: Assess expectedness against the IB or approved product information
f.statement: An unexpected ADR is one whose nature or severity is not consistent with the applicable product information (e.g. Investigator's Brochure for an unapproved investigational product, or package insert/SmPC for an approved product).
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

rows.quote: It is an adverse reaction where the nature or severity of which is not consistent with the applicable product information (e.g. Investigator’s Brochure for an unapproved investigational product or package insert / summary of product characteristics for an approved product).

f.title: Report to NPRA only events meeting all SUSAR criteria
f.statement: Before reporting to NPRA, the event must fulfil all of the following: it is an ADR; the suspected drug is the investigational product requiring CTIL/CTX (not the comparator or placebo); the ADR is serious; the ADR is unexpected; it occurred at a trial site in Malaysia; and the report contains the minimum information for expedited reporting.

f.title: Report local SUSARs from CTIL/CTX approval until expiry or end-of-study reports
f.statement: Reporting of local SUSARs starts on the date notification of CTIL/CTX approval is received from NPRA and must continue until the CTIL/CTX has expired or End of Study Summary Reports have been submitted for all Malaysian trial sites, whichever is later.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

f.title: Report six-monthly SUSAR line listings per protocol in which Malaysia participates
f.statement: Six-monthly SUSAR line listings may follow the global reporting timeline, but must be reported per protocol in which Malaysia participates. Individual SUSARs from trials not conducted in Malaysia need not be reported.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

f.title: Include minimum information in expedited reports
f.statement: An expedited report must include at least: an identifiable patient, the name of a suspected medicinal product, an identifiable reporting source, an event or outcome identifiable as serious and unexpected, and a reasonable suspected causal relationship.

f.title: Break the blind for expedited SUSAR cases
f.statement: When a serious adverse reaction is judged reportable on an expedited basis, it is recommended that the sponsor break the blind for that specific patient even if the investigator has not.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Request NPRA agreement in advance for blinded reporting where endpoints are serious outcomes
f.statement: When a fatal or other serious outcome is the primary efficacy endpoint and breaking the blind may compromise the trial, the sponsor should request NPRA in advance to submit blinded SUSAR reports or to exempt disease-related serious events from expedited reporting; when the blind is opened, a CIOMS-I follow-up update is sufficient.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

f.title: Update investigators on safety findings affecting subjects or trial conduct
f.statement: NPRA has no specific requirement on SUSAR reporting to investigators; however, sponsors should update investigators adequately when safety findings could affect subject safety, impact trial conduct or alter the IRB/IEC approval/favourable opinion.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX

f.title: Define the party responsible for safety reporting in the Clinical Trial Agreement
f.statement: The party responsible for safety reporting should be clearly stated in the Clinical Trial Agreement; where two companies run trials of the same product, only the company responsible for the trial in which the SUSAR arose should expedite it to NPRA.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Malaysia under a CTIL/CTX
